n8n.why: fallback pin of the whole assistant call

connector.none: an OpenAI Assistant keeps its instructions at OpenAI; there is no Claude connector, so the Claude side calls the same API over http

reads.note: the assistant's reply is fixed here because it comes from a remote assistant, not from a model the bench can swap. Calls follow the Assistants v2 API (thread, message, run, poll, tool outputs, list messages); a side that uses createAndRun gets the same run n8n 2.47.7's node (message.operation.js, v1.3+) with a connected tool first retrieves the assistant (GET /v1/assistants/{id}) and updates its tools to its own plus the connected ones (POST); it restores them after the run only when the assistant had tools of its own (this one has none). With an empty memory it calls createAndRun (POST /v1/threads/runs); POST /v1/threads (memory with earlier messages) and the thread's messages and runs (a given thread id) answer a side that takes those paths. The update registers the connected tool under its node name (Calculator1), so the run calls that name; checked in the image: the tool output submitted is 409.5.

branches: no IF/Switch; the run status is failed, so the node is expected to error
expect.offline: where a side reads the message list despite the failure, it gets an assistant message whose content is an image_file part only (see the n8n pin: output null)
